subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Then one week, heavy rain was expected.”?
options: Students began checking the screen like a game.
Soon, students began staying to draw, paint, or simply sit quietly.
The sun was the same, but the surfaces below it changed how much students suffered.
Students began checking the station to see how much rain had fallen.

本文沒有陳述「Soon, students began staying to draw, paint, or simply sit quietly.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The sun was the same, but the surfaces below it changed how much students suffered.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Then one week, heavy rain was expected. Students began checking the station to see how much rain had fallen.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
